NATIONAL SPORTS COUNCIL OF MALAYSIA ACT 1971

NATIONAL Sports CouNCcIL oF Malaysia (MODIFICATION)
ORDER 1988

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 7A
of the National Sports Council of Malaysia Act 1971, the Minister
makes.the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the National Sports Council of
Malaysia (Modification) Order 1988;

2. The Second Schedule to the National  Sports Council of
Malaysia Act 1971 in its application to the Federal Territory Sports
Council is modified as in the Schedule hereto.

3. The National Sports Council jof Malaysia (Modification)
Order 1981 is revoked.
